text: {"final": {"findings": [{"id": "R4", "statement": "Texts are not free text: notifications/sms.py has no send_sms(phone, text) function. Messages are queued with queue_sms(household_id: str, template_id: str, params: dict, *, now=None) -> SmsMessage, which renders an approved template from TEMPLATES via render(template_id, params). render() raises KeyError for a template_id not in TEMPLATES, and raises ValueError if the rendered text exceeds MAX_LENGTH = 140 characters (not 160). queue_sms() also raises RuntimeError if feature(\"sms_enabled\") is false and ValueError if the household's sms_ok is false; it appends the message to outbox/sms.jsonl (irreversible) and the gateway records delivery results in data/sms_status.json as {\"SMS-00001\": \"delivered\", \"SMS-00002\": \"failed\", ...}, readable via delivery_status().", "file": "notifications/sms.py"}]}}
